title: Single-use action authorization (only issued on ALLOW)

nonce.description: Single use. Store consumed nonces; reuse must be rejected.

action_digest.description: Digest of the exact canonical candidate. A different command is a different digest. Equal to the receipt's candidate_digest, per spec/canonicalization.md.

evidence_digest.description: Equal to the governing snapshot's snapshot_digest.

value.description: base64 with padding (RFC 4648 section 4) over the artifact with its signature member omitted, per spec/canonicalization.md.
